# LLM Observability

> LLM tracing with a Python library and collector service, a JSON API, and a TypeScript dashboard for traces, latency, tokens, and cost.

Languages: Python, TypeScript. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability

## Source

- [src/llm_observability/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/__init__.py): LLM Observability: tracing, metrics, a collector service, and a JSON API for a web dashboard.
- [src/llm_observability/alerts.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/alerts.py): An alerting rules engine over trace metrics.
- [src/llm_observability/analysis.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/analysis.py): Analysis over many traces: summaries, percentiles, and regression detection.
- [src/llm_observability/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/cli.py): Command-line interface for the observability platform.
- [src/llm_observability/core/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/core/__init__.py): Core tracing abstractions.
- [src/llm_observability/core/span.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/core/span.py): Core span types for tracing.
- [src/llm_observability/core/trace.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/core/trace.py): The :class:`Trace`: the tree of spans from one top-level operation.
- [src/llm_observability/core/tracer.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/core/tracer.py): The :class:`Tracer`: creates spans and maintains the parent/child context.
- [src/llm_observability/cost.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/cost.py): LLM cost modeling.
- [src/llm_observability/demo.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/demo.py): A worked example: instrumenting a simulated agent run.
- [src/llm_observability/diff.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/diff.py): Diffing two traces of the same operation.
- [src/llm_observability/exporters.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/exporters.py): Exporters: render and serialize traces.
- [src/llm_observability/formats.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/formats.py): Additional export formats: Chrome trace, CSV, and span-flattening.
- [src/llm_observability/instrumentation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/instrumentation.py): Decorator-based auto-instrumentation.
- [src/llm_observability/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/metrics.py): Conventions for recording LLM calls on spans, and metric aggregation.
- [src/llm_observability/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/llm_observability/sampling.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/sampling.py): Trace sampling.
- [src/llm_observability/search.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/search.py): Searching and filtering spans across traces.
- [src/llm_observability/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/service.py): The HTTP service (collector and JSON API) built on the standard library.
- [src/llm_observability/slo.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/slo.py): Service-level objective (SLO) tracking.
- [src/llm_observability/store.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-observability/blob/main/src/llm_observability/store.py): An in-memory trace store and the JSON views the dashboard reads.
